title: Sani e salvi agli amplessi amorosi
subtitle: Ferrando, Guglielmo, Don Alfonso, Fiordiligi, Dorabella and Despina: Act 2 finale (No. 31), section 6, from Così fan tutte

passages.label: Sani e salvi agli amplessi amorosi · Giusti numi! · Richiamati da regio contrordine
Ma cos'è quel pallor · Permettete che sia posto
Non signor, non è un notajo · Una furba uguale a questa · La Despina!
Già cader lasciai le carte · Un contratto nuziale?

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Così fan tutte, K. 588 (1790), Act 2 scene 18, No. 31 Finale, section 6 of 9
licences.author: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart (1756–1791)

licences.source: Lorenzo Da Ponte, libretto of Così fan tutte (1790)
licences.author: Lorenzo Da Ponte (1749–1838)
licences.notes: Words as printed in the Peters vocal score: gioja, Guglielmo (the libretto has Guilelmo), “o che giubilo”, cos' è as two words, perchè, stà, notajo, Despina's “or e tornata” (no accent), quà, và, and Guglielmo's “cantratto” for contratto, a print slip.

licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 341–347, bars 372–440 of No. 31
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: the No. 31 Finale (671 bars) read in fourteen page ranges, sung lines and piano each by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the zoomed page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by eight fresh proofreaders (two fixes in this section: the left-hand F3 tied to beat 2 in bar 6, and Ferrando's and Guglielmo's dotted eighth and 16th on “ra-bi-” in bar 24). The German singing translation is left out. All the singers of this section have a staff throughout, with rests where the print leaves a staff out; singers who do not sing in this section are left out. Cut from the one-file finale at bars 372–440: from the Andante (B♭ major, “Letzte Szene”) to the bars with fermatas before the Allegro. Con più moto from bar 48: the print places it over Despina's upbeat on beat 3 of bar 47; the file starts it at bar 48, after the double bar. Playback tempo: Andante at ♩ = 88, then Con più moto from bar 48 at ♩ = 120, from René Jacobs's recording (harmonia mundi), 2:45.
